redactionGap.problem: The flow fetched material before navigating, but the port only registered secrets at fill time, so the first snapshot after the navigation (already auto-filled) was returned unredacted.
redactionGap.fix: PrivateAuthPort.primeSensitiveValues(values) plus one call in the form flow before any effect; the values stay in the port closure and are never a ToolCall or model-facing input.
strictness: only a plain array of non-empty strings, at most 32 values of at most 4096 characters
accessors are rejected without being invoked; sparse arrays, subclassed arrays and non-arrays are refused
refused after close, and a rejected value is never echoed in the error
redactionGap.negativeProof: Removing the single primeSensitiveValues line from the flow makes the new end-to-end case fail (1/2): the first observation then carries the username and password.
coverage: port level: unprimed navigation leaks the echoed credentials; primed navigation scrubs title, url (raw and percent-encoded), node name and node text
flow level: every recorded observation, the steps and the outcome are free of username/password while the fill primitive still receives them
none profile: zero material calls, zero priming, zero observations, zero primitives

adapters.compatibility: AuthLocatorSession mirrors the real BrowserSession.resolveRegressionLocator signature; `NonNullable<BrowserSession["resolveRegressionLocator"]> extends AuthLocatorSession["resolveRegressionLocator"]` fails the build on drift.
adapters.negativeProof: A deliberately wrong session port (locator: string) makes tsc fail with "Type true is not assignable to type never".
adapters.rebasing: The session resolves against its own fresh snapshot, so the returned target is re-based onto the snapshot the flow holds; pageId must match and the node/frame must exist (and be visible) in that snapshot.
codes: LOCATOR_NOT_FOUND -> null (the only explicit "not present" signal, used by the optional OTP step)
node hidden in the current snapshot -> TARGET_HIDDEN
node or page absent / foreign page -> TARGET_NOT_FOUND
unknown failure -> RESOLVER_ERROR, abort -> CANCELLED; none of them become null
evaluator: criteria are evaluated by the real evaluateTechnical over the frozen criterion; a swapped criterion is refused with VALIDATION_ERROR

observed reasons come from the real evaluator: "Visible matching node observed", "Required owned evidence missing", "Locator oracle not implemented", "Truncated observation cannot prove absence", "Infrastructure/entry HTTP response blocks evaluation"
no owned evidence => unknown, never a pass (the same condition Root hit in the PG probe)
the built module imports only @localqa/domain, @localqa/contracts and @localqa/browser: no model, agent, tool-runner or Playwright import
adapters.discoveredConstraint: CriterionResult.evidenceRefs items are contract-typed as uuid, so an owned evidence ref must be a UUID; a non-UUID ref is refused by the contract validator (constant VALIDATION_ERROR), never silently accepted.

commands: cd apps/worker && node --test test/auth-flow.test.mjs test/auth-runtime.test.mjs test/auth-services.test.mjs test/auth-adapters.test.mjs test/auth-redaction.test.mjs   # 35/35
interfaceNotesForRoot: The adapter needs an owned-evidence source to turn a would-be pass into passed; evidence refs must be UUIDs (e.g. the redacted artifact id the fixture adds).
createAuthAdapters pins one frozen criterion; the flow must pass that same criterion (form mode always takes profile.formConfig.successCriterion).

A configured otpTarget that is absent rather than ambiguous: the real locator reports a 0-match as LOCATOR_NOT_UNIQUE, so it currently blocks as TARGET_AMBIGUOUS instead of skipping. Only LOCATOR_NOT_FOUND returns null.
The private port now exposes primeSensitiveValues; a caller that fetches material without priming repeats the original leak, so the Worker wiring must keep the priming inside the flow.
notImplemented: no finishAuth / import / OTP / handoff; a captured state still cannot be finished
no Worker.once / tick wiring; Stage.auth stays unwired
